Candidacy Period -

Hello Cordonites,

The season has finally arrived for the Presidential elections of Cordone to take place. We are extremely behind schedule so well have to rush this process a bit. As of right now, we are moving into a candidate declaration period. How does this work? Its simple:

1. Ensure you are a citizen. If you arent a citizen, unfortunately you will neither be able to become a candidate nor will you be able to vote in the election itself. Dont fret though, you can apply to become a citizen and youll have all the rights to do this in the next elections (which happen every two months) and more.

2. Now, if you are interested in running for presidency, simply declare your candidacy in a public medium and ping (inform) the Council. This means either in the RMB or in the Discord server. We dont have a dedicated channel for this yet in the Discord but we shall rectify this for the elections to come in the future.

3. How can you declare candidacy? Just follow the template below:

I, [nation name], hereby declare my candidacy in the March Cordonite Presidential Election.

[ping (inform) council]

4. Thats all there is to it. If you are really dedicated, you could create a campaign and post that to help your chances. Otherwise, all there is left to do is wait for the election results to be declared after the election process is finished.
